result.quote: and human bones will be burned upon you.
result.reason: The key paraphrases one clause of the cry, though its undefined “They” makes the agency less precise than the passive wording in the verse. More importantly, the question asks broadly what the man cries, and the same cry also announces Josiah’s birth and the sacrifice of the priests, so materially different answers are defensible. The wording should specify which part of the proclamation is sought.
